scope: Bounded independent source and retained-evidence review; no code or Git changes, no builds or timing runs

issues.location: after p.wait and thread.join(timeout=1), before OBSERVED
issues.problem: The helper does not verify that stdout/stderr reader threads have drained to EOF after bounded joins before claiming OBSERVED and sealing the raw snapshot. An unusually delayed reader can remain alive; current tiny retained transcripts themselves are internally consistent.
issues.requested_fix: Require both reader threads to be closed after join before OBSERVED. If either is alive, return UNVERIFIED and do not claim complete raw capture; preserve old helper and focused regression evidence.
issues.resolution: Explicit any(thread.is_alive()) guard raises before OBSERVED; raw record and case expose stream_capture_complete. Incomplete streams remain UNVERIFIED with retained partial evidence.
